findings.text: follow-on: the RERANK_POOL guard pins RERANK_POOL > 30, a hardcoded threshold, while the invariant the section comment asked for is that the pool exceeds the k the search tools return. The search-tool entry points default k=10 and already enforce the identity in code via pool = max(k, RERANK_POOL) (imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:891,1647), so the assertion is weaker than the stated ask (a k of 31-59 passed by a caller would satisfy max() but the guard would still hold at 60). It does prevent the stated regression to 30. Not a blocker.
